notes: No Wikiquote page exists. Quotes settled on MovieMistakes, with TV Tropes as a second source for the note. The note is the first half of Xian's real line ('...and that their mothers have sex with mules'), cut cleanly, so it stays. 'Now you drive me in Pedicab' is a fair unquoted nod to 'And now, you drive me in Pedicab.' Banana tree demolished by kicks: MixedMartialArts. Xian gets Kurt drunk before the bar fight: Kung Fu Kingdom.

vibe.verdict: Strong Thai food and the right training moments, but the bar is unnamed and the famous drunk dance itself never gets a line.
missing: Kurt's drunk dance in the bar (the bar test, the film's best-known scene)
Winner... palm tree (Xian, only an unprinted wink)
Tong Po kicks the towel out of the ring (Eric's fight, only an unprinted wink)
Underwater kicks (training at the lake, the back photo shows it but no line names it)
